items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-N-exact at source lines 4134-4137: the functor N from simplicial objects of an abelian category to chain complexes is exact. The author's proof at source lines 4139-4142 names two ingredients, the exactness of s and the functorial decomposition of N (and of the comparison map) from the decomposition lemma. Both are retained as context, so the card counts a short statement whose justification is a two-step pointer entirely available inside the package.
